set interfaces vlan unit 2 family inet a.template: set interfaces [parameter1] unit [parameter2] family inet address [parameter3]/[parameter4]

set interfaces ge-0/0/0 unit 0 family et.explanation: 配置接口的以太网交换端口模式为trunk。

set protocols bfd interface all.explanation: 在所有接口上启用BFD协议。

set protocols bfd session CE1 local-addr.template: set protocols bfd session [parameter1] local-address [parameter2] local-discriminator [parameter3]

set protocols bfd session CE1 local-addr.explanation: 配置BFD会话的本地地址和本地标识符。

set protocols bfd session CE1 remote-dis.command: set protocols bfd session CE1 remote-discriminator 15

set protocols bfd echo-mode enable inter.template: set protocols bfd echo-mode enable interface [parameter1] neighbor [parameter2]
set protocols bfd echo-mode enable inter.command: set protocols bfd echo-mode enable interface vlan.2 neighbor 10.1.1.3
set protocols bfd echo-mode enable inter.explanation: 在指定接口上启用BFD echo模式，并指定邻居地址。
